papers.approach: Theoretical framework connecting privacy accumulation and adaptive data analysis.
papers.contribution: Formalize data as consumable resource with intrinsic limits on reusability.

papers.title: SaGD: A Node-Level Differentially Private Graph Learning Framework with Sensitivity-Aware Gradient Descent
papers.problem: Node-level differential privacy on graphs requires complex sensitivity analysis and edge pruning.
papers.approach: Sensitivity-aware gradient descent with edge weighting and explicit gradient derivations.
papers.contribution: SaGD provides tight sensitivity bounds without edge pruning or black-box gradient clipping.

papers.title: Dynamics of Human-AI Collective Knowledge on the Web: A Scalable Model and Insights for Sustainable Growth
papers.problem: Human-AI co-produced knowledge on web exhibits feedback loops with quality/skill risks.
papers.approach: Dynamical model of archive size, quality, skill, and volume with policy levers.
papers.contribution: Identifies growth regimes and predicts LLM/human contribution shifts under different policies.

papers.title: Scalable and Provable Biclique-Preserving Clustering: The Power of Counting-based Approaches
papers.problem: Biclique-preserving clustering overlooks higher-order structure and requires expensive enumeration.
papers.approach: Edge-centric reweighting with counting-based approximation and graph reduction strategies.
papers.contribution: ECRC provides provable approximation guarantees with improved scalability over enumeration.

papers.title: PRISM: LLM-Guided Semantic Clustering for High-Precision Topics
papers.problem: Topic modeling requires rich LLM representations but incurs high cost and interpretability loss.
papers.approach: Distill LLM supervision into sentence encoder via sparse labeling and thresholded clustering.
papers.contribution: PRISM improves topic separability on narrow domains with minimal LLM queries.

papers.title: SMART: A Social Movement Analysis & Reasoning Tool with Case Studies on #MeToo and #BlackLivesMatter
papers.problem: Journalists lack timely, actionable insights into social movement discourse around events.
papers.approach: Multi-source collection, emotion extraction, transformer-based emotion forecasting.
papers.contribution: SMART enables early detection of discourse shifts on #MeToo/#BlackLivesMatter around elections.

papers.title: IntraAI: Bridging Human-AI Understanding Through Intelligent Interface Design
papers.problem: Black-box AI interfaces obscure model behaviors, hindering user autonomy and trust.
papers.approach: Interactive visualization of alignment signals and reasoning patterns via modular design.
papers.contribution: IntraAI transforms passive consumption into active human-AI collaboration through transparency.

papers.title: Sparse Causal Latent Features for Robust Multimodal Learning under Distribution Shifts
papers.problem: Multimodal models learn spurious correlations, degrading performance under distribution shift.
papers.approach: Gating mechanism selecting causal features via adversarial training and stability scoring.
papers.contribution: SCLF achieves robust OOD performance (73%) while maintaining in-domain accuracy (74%).

papers.title: Detecting Miscitation on the Scholarly Web through LLM-Augmented Text-Rich Graph Learning
papers.problem: Miscitation detection requires semantic reasoning but LLMs are costly and hallucination-prone.
papers.approach: Evidence-chain reasoning with LLM-GNN knowledge distillation and collaborative routing.
papers.contribution: LAGMiD reduces LLM inference while enabling scalable semantic-graph miscitation detection.

papers.title: Interpretable Dynamic Network Modeling of Tensor Time Series via Kronecker Time-Varying Graphical Lasso
papers.problem: Tensor time series yield large, uninterpretable dynamic networks; estimation is computationally intensive.
papers.approach: Kronecker product factorization for mode-specific networks with streaming extension.
papers.contribution: KTVGL achieves higher accuracy with lower computation than baselines; scales to stream data.

papers.title: PrivSplit: A Lossless Method for Prompt Privacy in Distributed Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.problem: Distributed PEFT enables cloud inversion attacks on edge embeddings, compromising privacy.
papers.approach: Split and compensate: edge retains private embedding part, cloud restores via compensation.
papers.contribution: PrivSplit is provably secure against reconstruction attacks with zero performance loss.

papers.title: Tracking the Stray Sheep: Understanding DNS Response Manipulation in the Wild
papers.problem: DNS manipulation scope and mechanisms poorly understood; dynamic resolution complicates detection.
papers.approach: Resolution path analysis leveraging CNAME chains and intermediate node attributes.
papers.contribution: Uncovers DNS manipulation strategies across 2,283 domains via global open DNS measurement.

papers.title: MiningWeb Evolution: A Dataset of DOM Changes Across Websites
papers.problem: Large-scale datasets capturing real-world web structural evolution remain limited.
papers.approach: Archive-derived longitudinal DOM parsing tracking XPath positions over 1000+ versions per site.
papers.contribution: MiningWeb provides 246M DOM node positions enabling web evolution pattern studies.

papers.title: Prototype Augmentation-based Edge-end Heterogeneous Collaborative Learning
papers.problem: Edge-end heterogeneous collaborative learning hampered by communication overhead and data privacy constraints
papers.approach: Prototype augmentation with local contrast and global alignment, virtual data generation via noise mixing
papers.contribution: PAECL framework reduces communication while training heterogeneous edge-end models without edge server data

papers.title: Intelli-Planner: Towards Customized Urban Planning via Large Language Model Empowered Reinforcement Learning
papers.problem: Urban planning relies on slow human experts or limits stakeholder involvement in deep learning approaches
papers.approach: Multi-agent DRL with LLM-based stakeholder satisfaction evaluation and knowledge enhancement module
papers.contribution: Intelli-Planner achieves better stakeholder satisfaction and convergence versus traditional and state-of-the-art methods

papers.title: BHGap: A Deep Iterative Prompting and Multi-stage Alignment Framework for Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition
papers.problem: Dynamic facial expression recognition lacks deep feature co-evolution and fine-grained audio-visual alignment
papers.approach: State-space model cross-modal prompt generator with coarse-to-fine multi-stage alignment and fusion
papers.contribution: BHGap integrates deep iterative prompting with continuous reciprocal generation across encoder layers

papers.title: Adaptive Graph Reweighting for Collaborative Filtering
papers.problem: GCN collaborative filtering sensitivity to graph algebraic connectivity causes performance degradation
papers.approach: Learnable edge reweighting via spectral embeddings and monotonic network with connectivity regularizer
papers.contribution: BoostGCN improves GCN performance by addressing spectral properties and bottleneck edges

papers.title: Decentralised Trust Layers for the Web: Towards Transparent AI-Powered Platforms
papers.problem: AI-mediated web experiences lack independent verification of model behavior and data provenance
papers.approach: Decentralized trust layer with transparency logs, model lineage registry, and privacy-preserving inference receipts
papers.contribution: DTL protocol enables verifiable model accountability with microsecond-scale cryptographic overhead

papers.title: UniSafe: Modality-Agnostic Hateful Content Detection via Shared-Space Projection
papers.problem: Multimodal hateful content detection fragile when modalities missing at inference time
papers.approach: Shared safety embedding space with frozen encoders, lightweight projectors, order-invariant aggregation
papers.contribution: UniSafe matches late fusion on full input while supporting missing-modality inference with single checkpoint

papers.title: Lang2Plan: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent System for Building Layout Planning
papers.problem: NL-guided layout planning requires strict input quality, lacks interactive refinement and immersive visualization
papers.approach: Multi-agent LLM decomposition with web-based 3D editor and ControlNet-guided diffusion rendering
papers.contribution: Lang2Plan enables robust layout generation from imperfect input with interactive 3D adjustment

papers.title: LegalKit: A Modular Toolkit for Efficient Legal AI Evaluation
papers.problem: Legal NLP lacks standardized, lightweight, extensible evaluation frameworks for diverse legal tasks
papers.approach: Unified toolkit integrating heterogeneous benchmarks with flexible configuration and web interface
papers.contribution: LegalKit promotes transparency, reproducibility, and comparability across legal AI research

papers.title: Starlink in the Wild: Multi-Perspective Measurements via DNS
papers.problem: Starlink terrestrial network architecture, user patterns, and security posture remain largely unexamined
papers.approach: DNS-centric measurement with DNS leakage analysis, passive data, and large-scale active scanning
papers.contribution: Reveals novel insights into Starlink's ground infrastructure architecture, operations, and security

papers.title: MePe: Rethinking Multimodal Chinese Idiom Reading Comprehension from a Metaphorical Perspective
papers.problem: Multimodal Chinese idiom comprehension overlooks literal-metaphorical discrepancy and context-dependent meanings
papers.approach: Literal-metaphorical semantic graph with mixture of idiom experts and collaborative understanding
papers.contribution: MePe framework achieves dual-meaning understanding through structured knowledge and expert specialization

papers.title: KEPo: Knowledge Evolution Poison on Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.problem: GraphRAG systems vulnerable to poisoning attacks that manipulate knowledge graphs and LLM outputs
papers.approach: Knowledge evolution poison attacks forging event backgrounds and interconnected knowledge evolution paths
papers.contribution: KEPo exposes latent GraphRAG security vulnerabilities through poisoned KG manipulation

papers.title: Graph-to-Tree: Topological Decomposition for Self-Supervised Learning
papers.problem: Graph representation learning lacks multi-scale signals and context-aware augmentation strategies
papers.approach: Tree decomposition with bag-level roles, context-aware augmentation, and tree-based contrastive similarity
papers.contribution: TopDSL framework injects multi-scale topological signals via tree decomposition for superior graph learning

papers.title: Understanding the Consequences of VTuber Reincarnation
papers.problem: VTuber reincarnation causes substantial losses but lacks quantitative analysis of industry impact
papers.approach: Large-scale empirical study analyzing 728K livestreams and 4.5B viewer interactions across 12 cases
papers.contribution: First large-scale study reveals reincarnation significantly damages career, audience, and industry

papers.title: negMIX: Negative Mixup for OOD Generalization in Open-Set Node Classification
papers.problem: Open-set node classification needs better OOD generalization and class compactness-separability
papers.approach: Negative mixup for OOD enhancement with cross-layer graph contrastive learning for prototypical MI
papers.contribution: negMIX achieves significant improvements via novel negative mixup and multi-layer contrastive learning

papers.title: StreamSense: Streaming Social Task Detection with Selective Vision–Language Model Routing
papers.problem: Live streaming platforms need real-time social task detection from partial asynchronous multimodal signals
papers.approach: Lightweight streaming encoder with selective VLM routing, cross-modal contrastive loss, IoU-weighted training
papers.contribution: StreamSense reduces latency and compute by selective escalation while maintaining high accuracy

papers.title: Long Story Short: Auditing U.S. Political Polarization in Recommendations for Long- vs. Short-form Videos on YouTube
papers.problem: Political polarization in YouTube's short-form recommendations remains understudied compared to long-form videos.
papers.approach: Matched audit comparing short-form and long-form video recommendations from 50,000 pairs analyzing political content exposure.
papers.contribution: First large-scale audit revealing fundamental algorithmic differences in polarization between YouTube Shorts and long-form recommendations.

papers.title: Beyond Single Pass, Looping Through Time: KG-IRAG with Iterative Knowledge Retrieval
papers.problem: RAG systems struggle with temporal reasoning when answers depend on serialized, dynamic, time-dependent data.
papers.approach: KG-iRAG couples time-aware planner with knowledge graph for iterative retrieval with explicit timestamps and temporal constraints.
papers.contribution: Framework improves temporal QA accuracy and calibration through constraint-guided iterative retrieval and temporal consistency verification.

papers.title: CC-OR-Net: A Unified Framework for LTV Prediction through Structural Decoupling
papers.problem: LTV prediction faces zero-inflated distribution with numerically overwhelming low-value users and critical high-value minority.
papers.approach: CC-OR-Net uses structural decomposition with ordinal ranking, residual regression, and high-value augmentation modules.
papers.contribution: Unified framework achieving superior trade-off in business metrics across customer lifetime value prediction on 300M+ users.

papers.title: Retrieval Collapses When AI Pollutes the Web
papers.problem: AI-generated content pollution threatens retrieval and RAG systems through source degradation and adversarial content infiltration.
papers.approach: Controlled experiments measuring retrieval collapse through SEO-style and adversarial content contamination scenarios.
papers.contribution: Demonstrates retrieval shift toward synthetic evidence; LLM rankers suppress harmful content better than BM25 baselines.

papers.title: Bandits, LLMs, and Agentic Web
papers.problem: LLM-based agents need adaptive decision-making frameworks for autonomous coordination and continuous learning in agentic ecosystems.
papers.approach: Tutorial on embedding multi-armed bandit algorithms into LLM agents balancing exploration-exploitation in autonomous systems.
papers.contribution: Practical MAB framework for agentic LLMs enabling personalized curation and multi-agent dialogue coordination.

papers.title: Prediction Guardian: A Distribution-based Real-time Anomaly Detection and Mitigation Framework for Online Advertising
papers.problem: DLRM predictions face distribution shifts and silent data corruption from retraining and feature pipeline vulnerabilities.
papers.approach: Prediction Guardian monitors prediction distributions using Jensen-Shannon divergence to detect anomalies and apply targeted mitigations.
papers.contribution: Framework stabilizes DLRM predictions through real-time anomaly detection and automated mitigation across multiple corruption scenarios.

papers.title: Towards Robust Detection of Chinese Toxic Variants via Dynamic Knowledge Graph–LLM Reasoning
papers.problem: Chinese toxic language detection fails on obfuscated variants like pinyin abbreviations and visual substitutions using static models.
papers.approach: Variant-KG constructs dynamic knowledge graph with LLM fine-tuning and collaborative detection using Think-Search-Generate paradigm.

papers.title: G-SEIR: A Graph-Enhanced Epidemic Forecasting System for Dengue Intervention
papers.problem: Dengue fever forecasting needs fine-grained, timely predictions integrating multi-source environmental data for intervention support.
papers.approach: G-SEIR integrates learnable SEIR epidemiological model with spatio-temporal graph neural network for automated data collection.
papers.contribution: End-to-end system outperforms 11 baselines on 2015 and 2023 dengue outbreaks with interactive district-level risk visualization.

papers.title: Beyond Patches: Superpixel Token-based Transformers for Attribute-Specific Fashion Retrieval
papers.problem: Patch-based transformers misalign with irregular attribute regions and suffer background noise in fine-grained fashion retrieval.
papers.approach: Super Fashion uses superpixel tokens guided by attribute-aware attention to generate semantically coherent image representations.
papers.contribution: First superpixel token-based ASFR framework achieves 1.84-9.35% MAP improvements over SOTA on FashionAI and DeepFashion.

papers.title: The Power of Penalties: Negativity-Aware Incentives for High-Quality Crowdsourced Data Labeling
papers.problem: Crowdsourcing quality labeling ignores fraud and fails to penalize harmful contributions without discouraging worker participation.
papers.approach: NAI mechanism combines Ability-Result Characteristic Function with signed Shapley values and dynamic stake pool for incentive design.
papers.contribution: Framework improves video labeling by 16.6% and reduces fraud by 33.9%, validated on NetEase platform with 80K monthly active workers.

papers.title: Line Graphs Are Here! Unlock a Simple Solution for Data Sparsity and Class Imbalance in Recommender System
papers.problem: Data sparsity and class imbalance persist as core challenges limiting recommender system development and performance.
papers.approach: LGDA transforms user-item bipartite graph to line graph, reformulating sparsity and imbalance as node classification problems.
papers.contribution: Plug-and-play augmentation strategy improves recommendation performance and robustness across four real-world datasets.

papers.title: TIME 2026: 2nd International Workshop on Transformative Insights in Multi-faceted Evaluation
papers.problem: Workshop call for papers on evaluating models and datasets in web mining, social networks, and ethics domains.
papers.approach: TIME workshop invites survey, evaluation, and review papers providing critical analysis from diverse perspectives.
papers.contribution: Workshop provides reference guides for researchers, enhances accessibility for newcomers, and fosters interdisciplinary exchange.

papers.title: Feasibility of Cryptography In a Blockchain-Enhanced ICS Security
papers.problem: BC+HE cryptographic architectures violate real-time constraints required for Industrial Control System security at network edges.
papers.approach: Resource-Constrained framework decouples security: lattice-based cryptography for real-time sensor layers, BC+HE for enterprise layers.

papers.title: Unveiling the Resilience of LLM-Enhanced Search Engines against Black-Hat SEO Manipulation

papers.contribution: First security analysis shows LLMSEs mitigate 99.78% traditional SEO attacks but vulnerable to rewritten-query and segmented-text attacks.

papers.title: FedBridge: Accelerating Edge-Assisted Federated Learning for Model-Heterogeneous Clients
papers.problem: Edge-assisted federated learning fails to accommodate model-heterogeneous clients with different architectures.
papers.approach: FedBridge deploys fusion model on edge servers using knowledge distillation and contrastive loss for heterogeneous client aggregation.
papers.contribution: System accelerates convergence 6.3x, improves accuracy 6.2-17.7%, with 89.51-96.13% communication overhead reduction.

papers.title: Weakly Supervised Multimodal Claim Verification with Entity-Graph Inference
papers.problem: Claims across modalities lack verification; weak signals abundant but labels scarce
papers.approach: Weakly supervised multimodal framework with entity-graph inference
papers.contribution: Consistent probabilistic claim verification from heterogeneous weak signals

papers.title: Following the TRAIL: Predicting and Explaining Tomorrow's Hits with a Fine-Tuned LLM
papers.problem: LLMs struggle extracting user preferences from sparse logs for real-time ranking
papers.approach: Fine-tuned LLM with contrastive learning on trend signals
papers.contribution: Joint prediction of popularity and faithful natural-language explanations

papers.title: RARD: Rationale-First Blockwise Autoregressive Diffusion in Rationale?Dominated Graph Generation
papers.problem: Graph generation often fails to preserve task-critical rationale substructures
papers.approach: Persistent homology filtration guides autoregressive diffusion generation

papers.title: Multimodal Deployment Risks in Manufacturing AI: A Survey of Boundary Failures, Taxonomy, and Governance in Industry 5.0
papers.problem: Multimodal manufacturing AI risks emerge at cross-modal boundaries not single models
papers.approach: Structured review synthesizing evidence across 80+ sources into taxonomy
papers.contribution: Five-layer multimodal-aware risk taxonomy linking mitigation strategies

papers.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
papers.problem: GCF and social recommendation require explicit embeddings with high parameter overhead
papers.approach: Construct user representations from social signals without per-user embeddings
papers.contribution: 50% parameter reduction achieving state-of-the-art across sparsity levels

papers.title: Multilingual Reference Need Assessment System for Wikipedia
papers.problem: Wikipedia editors manually verify claims; labor-intensive despite high daily edit volume

papers.contribution: Production-deployed reference need assessment outperforming benchmarks

papers.problem: Native agentic browsers hit memory, network, and security walls for multi-step workflows
papers.approach: WebAssembly integration for in-browser context, batched actions, and sandboxing
papers.contribution: WAB proof-of-concept reducing latency and securing untrusted agent execution

papers.title: Towards Graph Foundation Model: Node Feature Transfer Invariant Modeling on General Graphs
papers.problem: Graph foundational models lack Transfer Invariant Metadata across diverse graph types

papers.title: Graph Adversarial Defense via Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion against Influence Maximization Attacks
papers.problem: GNNs vulnerable to black-box influence maximization attacks maximizing perturbation spread
papers.approach: HSIC regularizer preserving task-relevant info while filtering adversarial perturbations

papers.problem: Urban flow prediction under extreme weather lacks fine-grained weather effect mechanisms

papers.contribution: Robust urban flow prediction under extreme conditions via weather separation

papers.title: Are LLM Web Search Engines Sustainable? A Web-Measurement Study of Real-Time Fetching
papers.problem: LLM answer engines creating redundant network traffic via repeated real-time fetching
papers.approach: Measurement study of ChatGPT and Claude tracing network behavior across 1000 queries
papers.contribution: Quantified sustainability concerns motivating caching and cooperative efficiency

papers.title: CIDC: Cluster Identification-Guided Dual Correction for Robust Short Text Clustering
papers.problem: Short text clustering struggles with sparse, imbalanced data and noisy pseudo-labels
papers.approach: Dual correction framework via cluster identification guiding pseudo-label refinement
papers.contribution: Reliable pseudo-labels improving deep clustering under distribution skew

papers.title: ViCSR: A Large-scale Benchmark and Lightweight Two-Stage Framework for Vietnamese Case-to-Statute Retrieval

papers.title: Towards Evidence-Aware Retrieval and Verification for Scientific Fact-Checking

papers.title: Evaluating Proactivity in Conversational Search through Anticipatory Retrieval

papers.title: Adaptive Personalisation for Effective Conversational Search Systems

papers.title: Faithful LLM-Assisted Question Answering for Technical and Academic Search

papers.title: Efficient Continual Adaptation of Generative Retrieval Systems over Dynamic Corpora

papers.title: Towards Structurally Robust Cross-Device Federated Recommendation
papers.problem: Federated recommendation suffers sparse signals and indirect user collaboration in cross-device scenarios.

papers.title: How Should Multimodal Information Be Chunked for Complex Question Answering?

papers.problem: LLMs integrated into search pipelines add cost and sensitivity to distributional shifts.

papers.title: Characterising the Effects of Social Conformity on Information Seeking in Mixed Human-AI Environments

papers.title: Topology-Conditioned Weak Supervision for Scientific Retrieval

papers.title: MANILA26: SIGIR 2026 Tutorial on Information Retrieval for Climate Change Impact
papers.problem: IR systems fail on interdisciplinary climate evidence synthesis with geospatial, time-series, multi-modal data.

papers.title: Trustworthy Personalized Retrieval in the LLM Era: Fairness, Bias Awareness, Privacy, and Multimodality

papers.title: Reasoning for IR & IR for Reasoning

papers.title: Retrieve, Rerank, Answer, Experiment: Hands-On IR Research with PyTerrier

papers.title: Temporal Information Retrieval and Extraction: From Foundations to RAG
papers.problem: Time dimension critical but neglected: systems must identify validity and recency of dynamic information.

papers.title: Second Workshop on Explainability in Information Retrieval
papers.problem: Explainability lags in IR despite complexity growth and societal demand for transparency.

papers.title: The 10th Workshop on Search-Oriented Conversational Artificial Intelligence (SCAI'26)

papers.title: ReNeuIR at SIGIR 2026: The Fifth Workshop on Reaching Efficiency in Neural Information Retrieval
papers.problem: Neural IR efficiency obstacles block first-stage deployment at scale; measurement and evaluation standards lacking.

papers.title: SynthIR: The First Workshop on Synthetic Content in Information Retrieval Ecosystems
papers.problem: Synthetic content proliferation breaks evaluation validity and user trust; retrieval systems struggle.
